sentences.text:
S y e d A b d u l K a r e e m A n d A n o t h e r v s T h e S t a t e O f
Telangana.,Rep.,Pp And ... on 18 July, 2023

1
 The Honourable Sri Justice E. V. Venugopal
 Criminal Petition No.10717 Of 2015
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed seeking to quash C.C.No.295 of 2015 on the file of XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad for the offences under Sections 498A, 406 IPC and Sections 4 and 6 of D.P. Act.

entities.text: XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent State.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that petitioner/accused No.2 and the de facto complainant is no more and therefore proceedings against them has to be abated.

He further submits that the Court below has disposed of the proceedings against the accused Nos.2 and 3 and closed C.C.No.295 of 2015 based upon the quashment order passed by this Court in criminal petition No.1917 of 2021.
Therefore, seeks to close the criminal petition.

4. Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State by furnishing the copy of online case status would submit that the proceedings before the Court below has been closed based upon the Order passed by this Court in CRL.P.No.1917 of 2021 without going into the technicalities.

Since, accused No.2 and de facto complainant are no more and accused No.3 is old aged and hence no useful purpose would survive in continuation of proceedings in the present criminal petition and therefore, seeks to close the criminal petition.
5. In view of the submissions made by both the learned counsel and taking the same on record, this Court is inclined to close this Criminal Petition.
6. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition stands closed.

Miscellaneous Petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
